turns.text: Absolutely, weekend lunch out is always a treat. How have things been at the logistics firm lately? Has it been busy?

turns.text: Yeah, I'm hoping to practice some guitar later this evening, and maybe hit the climbing gym tomorrow. It's the perfect way to spend the rest of the weekend.
